name: bossfight
description: A graph-based builder, verifier, and blind-critic loop for taking agent work past a concrete quality bar.

interface.shortDescription: Make agent work beat a real quality bar.
interface.longDescription: Bossfight turns a goal into a small dependency graph, runs isolated builders through deterministic checks, and feeds blind critic verdicts back until the integrated artifact wins.
defaultPrompt: Bossfight this feature against the best comparable tool.
Run a blind builder-critic loop on this design.
Turn this goal into a verified work graph.
